command:
set -eu
BASE=/srv/legacy2/incremental-archive-chain
cd "$BASE"
printf '%s\n' '--- safety checks ---'
for a in base.tar day2.tar day3.tar; do
  bad=$(tar -tf "$a" | grep -E '(^/|(^|/)\.\.(/|$))' || true)
  [ -z "$bad" ] || { printf 'unsafe member in %s: %s\n' "$a" "$bad" >&2; exit 1; }
done
for a in day2.tar day3.tar; do
  bad=$(tar -xOf "$a" deletions.txt | grep -E '(^/|(^|/)\.\.(/|$))' || true)
  [ -z "$bad" ] || { printf 'unsafe deletion in %s: %s\n' "$a" "$bad" >&2; exit 1; }
done
sha256sum chain.txt base.tar day2.tar day3.tar > /tmp/legacy2-media.before
stage=$(mktemp -d "$BASE/.recovered.stage.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
tar -xf base.tar -C "$stage"
for a in day2.tar day3.tar; do
  tar -xf "$a" -C "$stage" --exclude=deletions.txt
  tar -xOf "$a" deletions.txt | while IFS= read -r path; do
    [ -n "$path" ] || continue
    rm -f -- "$stage/$path"
  done
done
[ ! -e recovered ] || { printf '%s\n' 'recovered already exists; refusing overwrite' >&2; exit 1; }
mv "$stage" recovered
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' '--- media integrity after reconstruction ---'
sha256sum -c /tmp/legacy2-media.before
printf '%s\n' '--- recovered tree and contents ---'
find recovered -type f -printf '%P\n' | LC_ALL=C sort | while IFS= read -r path; do
  printf '[%s] sha256=' "$path"
  sha256sum "recovered/$path" | awk '{print $1}'
  sed -n '1,20p' "recovered/$path"
done
printf '%s\n' '--- deletion checks ---'
for path in obsolete.txt route.txt deletions.txt; do
  if [ -e "recovered/$path" ]; then printf 'UNEXPECTED_PRESENT %s\n' "$path"; exit 1; else printf 'ABSENT %s\n' "$path"; fi
done
